evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: The owned/rented opposition frames intelligence in proportionality terms — what you keep versus what you pay to use — enacting market-pricing as a classificatory distinction.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Calling the perspective an asset you keep performs market-pricing: it locates value in retained ownership against the commodity substrate, a cost-benefit framing of what is worth holding.
